title: recipe.toml
description: Experimental. What a Karni recipe is: a ready-made karni.yaml and when to start from it. Generated by python -m karni_cli.recipes. Never edit it by hand.

name.description: The recipe's name: its folder's name, or its entry point's. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. blank is taken by the blank start.

title.description: A short human name, e.g. Online shop.

purpose.description: What the app does, in one line of at most 80 characters.

use_when.description: Plain phrases of what someone asks for when this recipe fits, e.g. ["online shop", "sell products", "checkout"]. karni recipes list --match ranks recipes by the words a request shares with them.

usually_changed.description: What people usually change in the spec after starting from it, in plain words, e.g. ["the product fields", "the currency"].
